name: synthetic_single_origin_commute
description: Ten fictional workers assigned across workplace destinations and commute modes. All values are synthetic and uncalibrated.

structural_zero_reasons.reason: Walking excluded by synthetic model design.
Walking excluded by synthetic model design.
Transit excluded by synthetic model design.

assumptions: The cohort and exact margins are stipulated synthetic controls, not combined source observations.
Work-from-home entries retain a workplace association but contribute no workplace-commute mileage.
Two-person carpool mileage is attributed equally; the other rider may be outside this cohort.
Car and carpool use the same stipulated distance to each destination.
Transit, walking, and work from home contribute zero household automobile VMT; this is not a claim of zero transit emissions.
Workday counts, distances, bounds, and activities are illustrative and have no empirical calibration.
Commute VMT excludes non-work household travel.
The feasible table is a witness, not observed truth.
